pricing.details: Free to try: free to install, free credits to start, no card required for first use. The trial runs on GPT-5.6 Luna. After the trial, plans start at 23 €/month and a subscription unlocks all models, including Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra. Standard (individual) 23 €/month — 23 € of usage included each month; buy extra usage as needed; Agent, bulk tools and GPT functions, large choice of AI models, detailed usage reporting, Autosheet MCP (Google Sheets only). Business (team) 41 €/seat/month — 23 € of usage included per seat; shared extra usage as needed; Standard features plus team management, centralized billing and limits, centralized AI configuration, bring your own API key, custom AI endpoints. Enterprise: custom pricing (talk to sales) — Business features plus enforced bring-your-own-AI, SAML SSO, non-standard terms, high-priority support, guided setup and team training. Included usage does not roll over. Extra usage is bought for the space, stays valid 12 months after the most recent purchase, and needs an active subscription; Existing pay-as-you-go spaces with an active credit balance stay on pay-as-you-go for now. Each plan gives access to either GPT for Sheets – Autosheet or GPT for Excel – Autosheet. No annual ladder is published.
